Hi Jordan and team,

Thanks for taking the time — we have the ML systems coding screen scheduled for Thu Aug 5 at 10:00 AM PDT (60 minutes + 15 min debrief). Quick logistics below so the panel and candidate are aligned: 

- Candidate: Jordan Miles (BrightLabs).
- Interviewers: Karthik Iyer (ML infra), Laura Bennett (modeling/metrics), Connor O'Brien (backup proctor).
- Primary environment: ephemeral Gitpod workspace (link below) so Jordan can push a short repo and run tests.
- Live prompt: code + system design mini-task (we'll provide a small dataset and an inference throughput exercise).

Attachments: candidate-nda.pdf (please sign), panel-ops-checklist.md (internal).
Links: Gitpod workspace: https://gitpod.io/#workspace/jordan-ml-screen, CoderPad: https://coderpad.io/session/xyz-ml-2026, Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234

Jordan — can you confirm the time works for you and that you have a GitHub account we can add to the private repo (or we can provide a guest upload flow)? Also let us know if you need an iOS/Windows/Linux preference for running tests.

Karthik/Laura — if either of you want an alternate task or a small custom test seeded into the workspace, reply with the snippet by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Priyom

We plan to seed a very small dataset and a couple of micro-benchmarks. For the environment: please use the Gitpod workspace to run tests (it's configured with python 3.11, docker-in-docker is not enabled). You should be able to git clone into the workspace and run the eval script. If you prefer to work locally, we'll provide a zip of the repo beforehand.

Laura — per our debrief, I'll own the throughput bench, and would like Laura to own model-accuracy checks. Priyom — can you attach the small test harness (one-liner run script) to the workspace prior to the interview?

Also — I'm going to swap in an alternate question that focuses on KV cache management rather than a pure distributed-systems prompt; it should better map to Jordan's background.

-Karthik
